//: FREE MODELS ONLY. A paid model id here breaks the POC premise; the client refuses any model whose id does not end in ':free' unless allowPaid is true.

planner.//: nemotron-3-ultra reads a big capture best. Swapping it out on a bad afternoon did not help: the upstream limit is token-weighted, so every model refused the same ~12k prompt while answering a four-token one instantly. Prompt size is the lever, not model choice.

generator.//: Preferred model first, then openrouter/free, which picks whichever free model is actually serving. Learned by watching a fixed fallback list spend 20 minutes discovering that both named endpoints were down. Named models after the router are a last resort, not a queue.

limits.//: OpenRouter free tier: 20 requests/minute, 50/day (1000/day after a one-time $10 credit purchase). Free endpoints are SLOW and contended: a large generation can take minutes or never be served at all. Keep the timeout generous but the retry count low - a timeout means the endpoint is busy, and the fallback chain is the real remedy, so reach it sooner.
